# bids.export.write_contrasts { #fmrimod.bids.export.write_contrasts }

```python
write_contrasts(
    contrasts,
    mask,
    affine,
    output_dir,
    entities,
    stats=('beta', 'tstat', 'pvalue', 'se'),
)
```

Write contrast statistic maps as NIfTI files.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name       | Type                      | Description                                   | Default                             |
|------------|---------------------------|-----------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------|
| contrasts  | dict                      | ``{name: ContrastResult}`` from a fitted GLM. | _required_                          |
| mask       | NDArray\[bool\]           |                                               | _required_                          |
| affine     | NDArray, shape ``(4, 4)`` |                                               | _required_                          |
| output_dir | Path                      |                                               | _required_                          |
| entities   | BidsEntities              |                                               | _required_                          |
| stats      | sequence of str           | Which statistics to write.                    | `('beta', 'tstat', 'pvalue', 'se')` |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type         | Description   |
|--------|--------------|---------------|
|        | list of Path |               |
